title: A prayer for perfect bodily and mental health and vigour

verses.t: May I have voice in my mouth, breath in my nostrils, sight in mine eyes, hearing in mine ears, hair that hath not turned gray, teeth free from yellowness, and much strength in mine arms.
May I have power in my thighs, swiftness in my legs, stedfastness in my feet. May all my members be uninjured and my soul unimpaired.
